text: A single girl with very long hair in pink and purple and blue eyes looks at the viewer outdoors, bare-shouldered. She wears a sleeveless dress with detached sleeves, gloves and a bow.
A single girl with long purple hair and sidelocks looks out with a serious gaze, a yellow scarf around her neck. Bells in her hair, a grey sky and her reflection in a window behind her.
灰色の髪に猫耳としっぽを持つ猫娘を一人で。緑の瞳に、肩を出したシャツに黒いパンスト、靴。バッグを提げた華奢な姿で描いてください。
女の子と男の子を。黒髪の長い髪の女の子と、白髪を三つ編みにした男の子。長袖のドレスやジャケット、帽子、髪飾り。サイドの髪を垂らした二人を描いてください。
A greyscale style-parody of a single muscular boy with spiked hair, looking at the viewer in a martial-arts gi — a super-saiyan-like transformation, a shadow beneath him.
A single girl with long blonde hair, one eye hidden behind it, and blue eyes looks at the viewer. She wears an off-shoulder dress with a crown, a star motif and earrings glinting.

A single boy with red hair and brown eyes looks at a bird perched nearby, against a black background. He wears black gloves and a jacket with gold trim and notched lapels, parted bangs framing his face.
二人の女の子を、互いに見つめさせてください。金髪に赤い瞳、片方が相手の胸元に手を添えています。窓辺の枕のそばで頬を赤らめ、唇をわずかに開いた百合の雰囲気で描いてください。
A comic of a girl and a boy at a desk with a laptop, the girl in a white shirt with a blue necktie, the boy averting his eyes. An !? floats between them as they glance at each other.
白い髪の長い髪の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。赤い瞳に、袖なしの白いドレスに首輪とフリル、髪リボン、背には翼。髪に花を添えた姿で描いてください。
金髪のショートヘアの男の子を一人で。黄色い瞳に前髪を垂らし、白いシャツに前を開けたジャケットとネクタイ、髪飾りとイヤリング。花を添えた姿で描いてください。
白い髪のショートヘアの女の子を一人で。赤い瞳に、手の先まで余る袖のセーター、肩を出した装い、パンツ。半目 (ジト目) で、アンテナのような髪を立てたバーチャルYouTuber風で描いてください。
A single girl in a bodysuit holds a sword indoors by a door, an aura around her. She wears white gloves with a belt and armoured boots, a kunai at hand.
A single girl with blonde hair and blue eyes holds a book, a red hairband and a capelet on her. Frills and a ring, bangs between her eyes; a signature and watermark in the corner.
A single girl with hair in white and pink and aqua eyes looks at the viewer in a school sailor uniform. She wears a blue miniskirt with white socks and shoes, blunt bangs framing her face.
黒髪の女の子を、ジェスター帽をかぶって。目を閉じて誰かを抱きしめた場面を、英字のテキストと透かしを添えて描いてください。
女の子と男の子を室内で。茶髪や黒髪の長い髪と短髪に、紫の瞳。フードをかぶり、襟付きシャツに長袖。髪に花飾りを添えた二人を描いてください。
金髪の女の子と男の子を、互いに見つめさせてください。女の子は青い瞳の長い髪、男の子は黒いジャケットに黒いパンツ、ブレスレット。紫の瞳を添えて描いてください。
A single horned figure with black skin and black eyes wears a mask and a cloak, looking up, a bird nearby. A full-body drawing of a striking, otherworldly form.
A single boy with short spiked black hair and black eyes glances to the side in an alternate costume. He wears a yellow shirt with black shorts, collarbone showing, the artist's logo in the corner.
No humans — a single Pokémon sits against a pink background, electricity crackling around it, smiling with its mouth open and eyes closed. A full-body drawing.
緑の髪の女の子を一人で、室内で。黄色い瞳に、ベレー帽とケープ、黒いスカート、イヤリング。携帯電話と楽器を手にした姿で描いてください。

A single girl with brown eyes in a military uniform holds an assault rifle, facing the viewer. She wears a helmet with knee pads and a pouch, sleeves rolled up, a braid in her hair, against a floral background.
三人の女の子を、こちらを見つめさせてください。カチューシャや王冠を着けた別衣装姿で、顔に傷跡と逆立った髪、二股の眉。上の歯をのぞかせ、ほんのり頬を赤らめた面々を、英字のテキストを添えて描いてください。
オレンジ髪の長い髪の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。赤い瞳に、肘までの白い手袋、パンツ。歯を見せて笑い、イヤリングを着けた豊かな体つきで描いてください。
女の子と男の子を。赤い髪に赤い瞳、青い髪に黄色い瞳。襟付きシャツに首輪、パンスト、ショートパンツ、背には翼。ハートを添えた男女ペアの場面で描いてください。
女の子と男の子を。茶髪や黒髪の長い髪と短髪、茶色の瞳。白いシャツの制服にプリーツスカートとニーソックス、男の子はパンツ。互いに寄り添う場面で描いてください。
二人の男の子を、互いに見つめさせてください。金髪や茶髪の逆立った髪に、白い襟付きシャツの制服。白い背景で、仲睦まじい場面で描いてください。
A single girl with long black hair, blunt bangs, animal ears and red eyes glances to the side. She wears a white shirt with a necktie and black gloves, a cup and food beside her.
A profile of a single girl with very long grey hair holding a sword. She wears a dress with puffy sleeves and boots with high heels, a flower tucked in her hair.
白と茶色の毛並みに紫の瞳、しっぽを持つ色違いのポケモンを一匹だけ、動物に焦点を当てて。額に宝石を光らせ、枕を口にくわえ、怒りマークと動きの線を添えて描いてください。
Two girls together, one with very long black hair, the other aqua-haired, in sailor collars. They wear red and blue skirts with bows, fire beside them, earrings glinting.

Two girls together, one with white hair, the other long-haired, blue eyes bright. They wear neckties with hair ribbons and clips, making heart shapes with their hands — a crossover, a red necktie among them.
A comic with two girls and a boy in school uniforms indoors, the girls in sailor collars with neckerchiefs. One in a dress, another in pants, a shaded face and English speech bubbles between them.
A single girl with grey hair and aqua eyes wears a kimono with a hat, a bow and ribbon, a flower tucked in her hair. Socks and a bracelet, bangs between her eyes.
A single girl with very long pink hair in a ponytail, an ahoge and pink eyes. She wears a sleeveless kimono with detached sleeves and a sash, sidelocks framing her face, a fuller figure.

A girl and a boy glance at each other, one with grey and red streaked hair, animal ears poking up. They wear jackets with black fingerless gloves, a clip and ornament in their hair, bangs between their eyes.
女の子と男の子を。黒いジャケットに黒いスカートやショートパンツ、帽子と蝶結び、髪リボン。赤や白のリボンを添えた二人を描いてください。
Two girls with long black hair, shown in multiple views and drawn chibi. They wear coats with black fingerless gloves and belts, makeup and blue nails, buttons and a buckle on their coats.
複数の男の子を室内で。茶髪や青髪、赤髪に、片方は三つ編み。褐色肌の子もいて、別衣装姿で枕を囲み、爪に色を塗ったバーチャルYouTuber風で描いてください。隅に透かしを添えて。
ピンク髪の女の子を一人で。赤い瞳が記号の形をし、尖った耳、肩を出したドレスに離れた袖、背には翼。歯を見せて笑い、ハートを添えた姿で、署名を添えて描いてください。
白と赤の混ざった長髪に獣耳の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。赤い瞳に、ジャケットにニーソックス、ショートパンツ、髪リボン。武器を手にした姿で描いてください。
茶色の長髪を三つ編みにした女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。緑の瞳に前髪を垂らし、黒い手袋と黒いニーソックス、ブーツ。剣を構えた姿で、隅に twitter のIDを添えて描いてください。
A single girl with long blonde hair in twintails, an ahoge and purple eyes in a school uniform. She wears a white shirt under a jacket with a pleated skirt and thighhighs, a bow and weapon at hand.
Two girls with brown hair in a school uniform, one with sidelocks, a flower and clip tucked in their hair. They wear sailor collars with ribbons, eyes green and purple, bangs between them.
A single horse girl with blonde hair in a ponytail, horse ears and green eyes looks at the viewer outdoors. She wears a white shirt under a jacket, one eye hidden behind her hair.
女の子と男の子の二コマ漫画。長い髪の女の子と、灰色の髪に褐色肌の男の子。ベストの制服をまとい、窓辺で顎に手を当てて考え込む場面を、左右で結んだ髪を添えて描いてください。
二人の男の子のモノクロのコマ漫画。室内で、片方は包帯を巻き、タオルを添えています。鏡のそばで口を閉じた場面で描いてください。
黒髪のショートヘアに猫耳の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。肩を出した白いシャツの幅広の袖にチョーカー、アホ毛。舌をのぞかせた姿で描いてください。
二人の女の子を。黒髪や灰色の髪に、片方は三つ編み。白いシャツの制服にジャケット、髪飾りとリボン。豊かな体つきで、前髪を垂らした姿で描いてください。
A single girl with short black hair and purple eyes looks at the viewer, bare-shouldered. She wears a dress with gloves and a hat, a bow and ribbon, cleavage showing, an ornament in her hair.

Two virtual-youtuber girls in school uniforms, one with white hair, the other red, red eyes bright. They wear white shirts with short sleeves and a dress, ornaments in their hair — sailor collars among them.

A single girl with long purple hair rests a hand on her face, looking at the viewer against a pink background. She wears a jacket with pants and sneakers, headphones on, a bandaid, a bottle and an instrument beside her.
女の子と男の子を。ピンク髪や緑髪に、黄色い瞳。帽子とジャケット、長袖や半袖、ブーツ、チョーカー。前髪を垂らした二人を描いてください。
赤い髪のボブの女の子を、複数の角度から。赤い瞳の片方を前髪で隠し、半袖の装いに黒いショートパンツ、裸足。設定資料のように複数のポーズを並べたちびキャラで描いてください。
人物のいないメカを、宇宙を背に。剣を構えた写実的なモビルスーツ型ロボットが、星空のもとで戦う場面を。隅にロゴとコピーライト名を添えて描いてください。
A single girl with long brown hair and red eyes smiles, a hair bow and sidelocks framing her face. Against a red background with Chinese text.
Several boys together, hair in black, white and green with streaks, one with a hood and a bandaid. They share some food, tongues out, eyes green and yellow, bangs between their eyes.
A single boy with black hair and purple eyes looks at the viewer outdoors against a cloudy sky. He wears a Japanese-style short-sleeved top worn open with shorts and a belt, a hat with a bow.

A single girl with grey hair in two side-up tails and blue eyes wears a blue kimono with a heart motif, her nails painted blue. Sparkles around her, a little animal nearby, sidelocks framing her face.
A chibi girl with long brown hair, an ahoge and bangs between her eyes in a school uniform. She wears a white collared shirt worn open and off-shoulder with puffy sleeves, a bow tucked in.
二人の女の子を、こちらを見つめさせてください。黒髪のショートに、白い襟付きシャツの半袖とドレス、カチューシャ、赤いリボン。カップを手に、歯を見せて笑った姿で描いてください。
黒と赤の混ざった髪の女の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。赤い瞳に、白い襟付きシャツに前を開けたジャケット、チョーカー、スカート。食べ物を添えた豊かな体つきで描いてください。
A single girl with hair in blue and white, bare-shouldered, a flower tucked in her hair. She wears makeup with eyeshadow, lips drawn in detail, petals drifting around her.
女の子と男の子を。青やピンクの混ざった髪に、袖なしのシャツ、目の下にほくろ。点のような目をして、紙を手に英字の吹き出しで会話する場面で描いてください。
A single girl with very long white hair and pink eyes looks at the viewer. She wears a white shirt under a jacket with a necktie and a hairband, a hair ribbon tucked in, bangs between her eyes.
赤い髪のショートヘアの男の子を一人で、こちらを見つめさせてください。緑の瞳に、ジャケットに手袋、イヤリング、パンツ。背景をぼかし、歯を見せて笑った姿で描いてください。
A single girl with hair in black and white in a sailor collar, glasses on, wings behind her. She wears a white shirt with socks, a bag beside her, her nails painted, earrings glinting.
A single girl with short brown hair and blue eyes grins widely. She wears a bare-shouldered dress with short sleeves and thighhighs, white gloves and a hair bow, shoes beneath.
黒い長髪をツインテールにした女の子を一人で、屋外で。黄色い瞳に前髪を垂らし、白いシャツの制服にプリーツスカート、髪飾りとリボン。すらりとした姿で描いてください。
白とオレンジの混ざった長髪に獣耳の女の子を一人で。紫の瞳にアホ毛、半袖の装いにネックレス。豊かな体つきで描いてください。
A single girl with pink hair sings angrily into a microphone, sharp teeth bared. She wears headphones, a television behind her.
A single girl with blonde hair and purple eyes wears a black dress with frills and a black bow, pantyhose and shoes. A necklace at her throat, an ornament in her hair, bangs between her eyes.

A single virtual-youtuber girl with long hair, animal ears and antlers, green eyes bright. She wears a green dress with elbow gloves, leaves and a blue butterfly drifting around her, small horns among her hair.
茶色のショートヘアの女の子を一人、ちびキャラで。ベレー帽に青いリボン、ジャケットに青いスカート、ハイヒールのブーツ、手首の飾り。別衣装姿で描いてください。
女の子と男の子を室内で。茶髪の長い髪と短髪に、紫の瞳。ジャケットの制服にスカートやパンツ、髪飾りとリボン。すらりとした二人を、隅に作者名を添えて描いてください。
A monochrome comic of four boys, one in glasses, one with a dragon-like look. They wear hoods down with backpacks, a v-shaped brow on one, speech bubbles between them.
No people — a military airplane flying above the clouds, seen from above, a glint of light on it. A signature and twitter handle in the corner, the aircraft the focus.
赤い髪のショートヘアの男の子を一人で。青い瞳に逆立った髪、白いシャツに黒いジャケット。拳銃を構えた姿を、男性にフォーカスして描いてください。
二人の女の子を室内で。茶髪のとても長い髪に、緑の瞳、褐色肌の子も。白い襟付きシャツにカチューシャ、赤いリボンと蝶結び。食べ物を添えた姿で描いてください。
A single girl with red hair in twintails and red eyes, a maid with coloured skin. She wears bandages and a chain, an eyepatch over one eye, a necklace at her throat, a full moon behind her at night.

A comic of a girl and a boy as siblings, the boy with blue hair, the girl with grey hair, bangs between their eyes. They wear school uniforms with neckties — an official alternate costume, motion lines and a speech bubble between them.
Two girls together, one with brown hair, the other purple-haired in a ponytail, eyes brown and yellow. They wear dresses with short sleeves, a braid and a flower tucked in, one grinning widely.
A single girl with long blonde hair wears a blue star-print dress with striped pantyhose and a jester cap. A full moon behind her against a black background, a star motif nearby.
A single girl with blue hair faces the viewer with a :d grin. She wears a cardigan over a grey pleated skirt with buttons, a hair bow tucked in, curtains behind her, bangs between her eyes.
A single girl with very long pink hair wears a frilled dress with short sleeves and shorts. A flower and hair bow tucked in, earrings glinting, collarbone showing, an ornament in her hair.
青い瞳の男の子を一人で、赤い背景に。白い着物をまとい、逆立った髪にヘッドホン、顔にマーク。満月と煙を背に、片手を顔に添えた姿で描いてください。
Three women, aged up and older, one in a side ponytail, another in a bun. Flowers tucked in their hair, one raising an index finger, hands pressed together, long lashes framing their eyes.

A single girl with long black hair, blunt bangs and black eyes, a halo above her, against a black background. She wears black gloves with an ascot, small wings behind her, a mole under one eye, glowing softly.
Two girls together, one with brown hair, the other with a braid and purple hair, animal ears and a tail. They wear dresses under jackets worn open, ornaments in their hair, shoes and socks beneath.
A single boy with short blue hair holds a game controller indoors, upper teeth showing. He wears a short-sleeved top with pants, a sparkle beside him, bangs between his eyes.
A single girl with white streaked hair in a braid holds some food, her hair floating. She wears a kimono with her nails painted blue, an ornament tucked in her hair.
A four-panel comic of two girls, one with purple hair, animal fox ears poking up, in an off-shoulder top. They glance at each other, a heart between them — a gentle yuri scene, green eyes bright.
アクアブルーの髪の男の子を一人で、横顔で、上半身で。アイマスクを着け、牙をのぞかせてにやりと邪悪な笑みを浮かべた姿を、隅に twitter のIDを添えて描いてください。
A chibi girl with short blonde hair, animal ears and small horns, her hair in a bun. She wears a frilled dress with long sleeves and a hairband, a flower tucked in her hair.
二人の女の子を室内で。青いとても長い髪をツインテールにし、白いシャツの半袖にネクタイ。爪に色を塗り、カップと包帯を添えた姿を、作者名と日付を添えて描いてください。
二人の女の子を、こちらを見つめさせてください。紫の髪にアホ毛、青や紫の瞳。制服にプリーツスカート、長袖、リボン。歯を見せて笑った豊かな体つきで描いてください。
雨の降る草むらにいるポケモンを一匹だけ、下から見上げる構図で。目を閉じて口を開けた姿を、屋外の場面で描いてください。人物は登場しません。
人物のいないポケモンを一匹だけ全身で、ピンクの背景に。影を落とした構図で、キャラ名とコピーライト名を添えて描いてください。
女の子と男の子を。青い髪に青い瞳、灰色の髪。白いジャケットにベストとネクタイ、ポケットに手を入れています。ロリポップなどのお菓子を手にしたボーイッシュな女の子と男の子の場面で描いてください。
